history.reviewCoverage: All changed PNGs inspected, unchanged hashes checked; two recordings sampled before final test-only bridge.

recordingInspection.extraction: Playwright bundled ffmpeg output-r1 PNG decoding, then Pillow contact sheets.60approximate sequential output samples were inspected in7contact sheets; a keyboard-selection frame and the Creator return frame at23.60s were inspected at full size.
limitations: Output sampling may miss brief states and cannot prove continuous smoothness, exact latency, all motion events or reduced-motion equivalence.
All3 recordings contain video only; no perceived spatial audio was inspected.
The near-end full frame directly shows settled Synthetic SC02 Creator on the returned Creator Library, improving the earlier endpoint limitation.

overall.rationale: The two confirmed local experience defects resolve after bounded repair and recapture. Real chest/light/Creator composition/save/reopen/return,30actual selected model views and six additional effect views are supported. The unresolved vase finish, protected Crossdeck shared-experience gate and unsupported keyboard/focus/motion/audio/adverse/full-consumer obligations prevent significant or production acceptance.

observations: Gallery staging removes the obstructing inherited room tables; floor models are separated, table props sit on a modeled support table, and wall assets are placed at useful heights.
All30 framed Studio model views are now legible, including the painting's complete artwork and the banner's complete blue cloth, crest and notch clear of the window.
The three composed scenes visibly show localized colored illumination and presentation marks in an uncluttered Gallery.
dimensions.limits: This resolves the confirmed showcase/occlusion finding. It does not grant premium asset-catalog completion while the vase finish remains blocked, or certify all effect motion/audio.

observations: Title/status, authoring actions, preview/environment controls, main canvas and contextual docks remain distinct on desktop.
Vertical rail and internal Library/Hierarchy/Saved tabs still visibly duplicate destinations.
dimensions.limits: Duplication is an observation with unknown baseline/new-introduction provenance; no new regression or broad redesign is asserted.

observations: Titles and inspector type headings are readable and brand typography is distinct from authoring controls.
Secondary metadata, category chips and instructions remain small and dense; the390px layout fits them through wrapping and vertical flow.
dimensions.limits: No font-size, text-zoom or contrast conformance is certified from these screenshots.

observations: Desktop grouping/separators are consistent.
The constrained repair separates control rows from the render area and puts selected-object details beneath it, restoring usable scene space.
dimensions.limits: Dense category and hierarchy sections remain a learnability limitation; no user-efficiency test is claimed.

observations: Physical assets and light/effect types have contextual controls with appropriate labels.
Point-light enabled/color/intensity/range/falloff controls correspond to a visible real lighting change.
Projection controls expose pattern/opacity; portal exposes style/speed; spot exposes angle/softness and ambient explicitly explains scene-wide behavior.
The recorded model-selection strip and framed details demonstrate a useful ordinary selection alternative.
dimensions.limits: Controls and markers alone do not prove isolated spot/ambient illumination, all transforms/collision, or all cancellation and persistence paths. The card's visible Add intent remains less explicit than its accessible Add name.

observations: Dark primary text/outlines and light-shell dark text are distinguishable from their surfaces.
The light-theme scene remains pale: floor/walls and the white clue have weak separation at the far camera scale.
dimensions.limits: No measured WCAG pass/failure is inferred. Theme and authored lighting contributions were not isolated.

observations: Control shapes, blue selected states, dock structure and type labels remain coherent across themes/families.
New models render with the same authored form in both pipeline evidence and actual Studio, while their regular procedural grain remains a deliberate simplified finish.
dimensions.limits: Creator-only consistency does not establish Crossdeck/Player/Guided shared-consumer consistency.

observations: Populated editor, light disabled/enabled, named composition save, Saved entry, loading/preparing, working-draft reopen and library return are represented.
Preparing the synthetic3D environment provides explicit loading feedback.
dimensions.limits: Inherited assistant-ready/docked/closed states, empty asset search, invalid settings, resource failure, adverse state and recovery were not independently covered by this packet.

observations: All workstation actions now fit or wrap within390px, including the complete Reset Workspace Layout control.
Canvas controls sit in flow above the render area, transform tools have a separate column and the selected-object card is below the scene.
The full-page image is390 by1071 and uses vertical scrolling instead of horizontal clipping.
dimensions.limits: Width-fit and retained canvas are supported; physical phone/touch, zoom and native ergonomics remain unaccepted.

observations: All30 selected-model/framed outcomes were inspected.
The recording exposes an ordinary labeled model-selection strip; the Brass compass control has a visible focus treatment with the corresponding selected/framed model.
dimensions.limits: This is limited supporting selection evidence. A full keyboard-only entry, composition creation/save/reuse, transform, assistance and return path was not independently traced.

observations: The labeled selection strip has a visible outline on the selected/focused Brass compass control, while scene selection and inspector agree.
dimensions.limits: Full focus order, all control visibility, trap avoidance and focus return after overlays/docking remain pending. Selected styles elsewhere are not automatically called keyboard focus.

observations: The paired enabled/disabled point-light images visibly change chest, floor, walls and nearby table.
The recording and status area show composition save, scene save/preparation and working-draft reopen with the named Saved item retained.
dimensions.limits: The3000ms keyboard feedback budget and exact authored equality are not independently measured. Reported counters are supporting software observations only.

observations: All3 final recordings were decoded into approximately1fps sequential samples; natural entry, changes of selection, composition/save/reopen and normal-motion simulation states were inspected.
Particle-like speckles and portal/effect presentations have visible still evidence; screenshots show timeline states.
dimensions.limits: This is sampled inspection, not continuous playback. Smoothness, exact timing, pulse/entrance quality, cancellation and reduced-motion equivalence remain pending. All3 WebM streams are video-only; no perceived audio was inspected.

observations: The real recording enters Studio from the Creator Library, places a chest/composition, reaches Saved, reopens the scene and retains the visible chest and saved composition.
A frame extracted near23.60s shows the returned Creator Library with the settled Synthetic SC02 Creator account, resolving the earlier unsettled recording endpoint limitation.
dimensions.limits: This does not certify every saved property or independent instance identity. Contextual Crossdeck/Lens desktop-phone continuity is not supplied.

observations: Family/type labels and contextual controls support object-versus-effect distinctions.
Inspectable child entities make reusable compositions understandable as editable groups.
Many category chips, a separate type selector, duplicated destinations and truncated prefixed hierarchy names still add scanning cost.
dimensions.limits: These are concrete layout observations; no learnability or efficiency metric is claimed.

observations: An authenticated synthetic Creator visibly adds an actual modeled chest, receives real light response, saves/reuses a named composition, reopens the scene and returns to the same named Creator account.
All30 actual Studio model views and the supplemental symbol/footprint/writing/portal presentations are visible local outcomes.
dimensions.limits: Player Lens, Guided/native consumer delivery, perceived spatial audio, physical AR, full Creator-to-Player completion and owner acceptance remain unproved.

observations: The shell states AI unavailable with phrase rules while ordinary editing remains exposed.
Projection help explicitly describes a surface overlay and unavailable occlusion-aware projection; portal is described as a presentation phenomenon without travel/progression authority.
The inspector truthfully states current Player/native use of authored Guided alternatives; unsupported automatic proximity and live cloth simulation are not presented as working.
A labeled model-selection strip is visibly available as an alternative to direct3D selection.
dimensions.limits: Labels do not prove a meaningful accessible Player Guided outcome. Denial/error/recovery and audio-unavailable journeys remain pending.
